desc:
Use a portal gun, fight people with high-tech weapons, switch through different portal fluids for different portals, shoot through portals, explore the different locations(adding more frequently), find tools around the map

Suggestion board in-game to suggest features and give feedback

Latest changes:
-Added material guide GUI to describe all materials and how to get them
-Made portal travel much smoother by figuring out how to remove the delay for entering portals
-Changed portal texture, added multiple layers to improve spinning animation
-Added portal entry effect
-Fixed unpaired portals letting you in
-Improved portal shooting mechanism

beware of glitches
